summary: Monument Mountain lookout, Kootenai County: camp and platform tower in the early 1920s, 1953 L-4 tower, removed 1975; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 20-foot treated timber L-4 tower, replacing a log cabin with cupola
facts.status_note: L-4 tower removed in 1975; no source describes what remains on the site

visit.trail_note: Idaho Fire Lookouts labels the site drive-up. Neither page says whether a road reaches the summit today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Not resolved. The Forest Fire Lookout Association names the Coeur d'Alene National Forest; Idaho Fire Lookouts names the Idaho Department of Lands. The story reports both.

sources.title: Cabin Architecture

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today, so the story says so. The visit note records only the drive-up label. Agency conflict left open. Only two lookout pages; the 1957 couple appears on one page only. Cdil says L-4 cabs were built until 1952, while this tower is dated 1953; the story uses only the 14x14 definition, and the date gap is not resolved.
